test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: If 20 March 2011 was Sunday, then what was the day of the week on 20 March 2019?
solution: Given: **20 March 2011** was Sunday. Now, 2011 to 2019 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year). And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year.
